title: Temple Construction & Architecture
subtitle: Building a Sacred Landmark in Vedic Nagara Architecture Style on the Banks of Ganga
overviewTitle: Vedic Nagara Architecture & Sacred Mandir Construction
overviewSubtitle: Ancient Stone Craftsmanship & Modern Pilgrimage Complex
overviewDesc1: Shri Gaurishankar Baikunthnath Dham is being expanded and beautified according to authentic Vedic Shilpa Shastra guidelines. The complex features traditional Nagara style shikharas, carved stone pillars, and sprawling parikrama halls designed to accommodate thousands of devotees.
overviewDesc2: Crafted using premium carved Chunar sandstone and traditional interlocking stone techniques without structural iron, the temple architecture ensures a timeless structural lifespan spanning centuries.
overviewDesc3: The ongoing expansion includes a grand Ganga Aarti view deck, multi-storey Annadana hall, Vedic library, Yagnashala, and spacious guest rooms for visiting sanyasis and pilgrims.
arch1Desc: Majestic central tower rising over the Garbha Griha, crafted according to ancient temple proportions.
arch2Desc: Intricately carved stone pillars showcasing motifs of Lord Vishnu, Lord Shiva, and sacred lotus flowers.
arch3Desc: Traditional mortarless stone interlocking method ensuring structural permanence for centuries.
arch4Desc: Expansive paved Ganga ghat promenade for mass evening Ganga Aarti and holy dips.
stat4Label: Free Meal Hall & Sacred Vedic Fire Altar
